title: EquivalenceScores
description: Per-dimension equivalence scores (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §26). Keys are one of the eight labels in EquivalenceDimension::label() ("Behaviour", "Interface", "Configuration", "Schema", "Structure", "Operations", "Performance", "Binary"). A `null` value means the dimension was never measured and MUST NOT be treated as 0.0 or 1.0 — see EquivalenceScores::composite() in crates/kakashi-core/src/dimension.rs.
